title: Version 17.13.1
body_markdown:
*Released February 19th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Latest Visual Studio Preview is very slow loading Intellisense on large solutions | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Latest-Visual-Studio-Preview-is-very-slo/10839840) |
| Error "The specified network password is not correct." when trying to debug on iOS using Hot Restart | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Error-The-specified-network-password-is/10836918) |
| Removed the command line arguments dropdown to mitigate a UI hang in the Unreal Engine experience. |  |

---

From all of us on the team, thank you for choosing Visual Studio. If you have any questions, please reach us on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/VisualStudio) or [Developer Community](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/VisualStudio?ref=vs_releasenotes).

**Happy coding!**  
*The Visual Studio team*
